main_topics.reason: The user decided to resign because of their health and asked for help writing and warming the letter.
The user came wanting to talk without being judged, described being tired of fighting for support, and later said the letter made them tear up and feel calmer.
The user described fatigue, mistakes at work, and crashes lasting two days as the main reasons they felt unable to continue working.
The user described receiving no concrete support from HR and engaged with the suggestion of occupational health and specific adjustments.
The user asked for a proper explanation of pacing and said the explanation finally made sense.

output.summary: The user described long COVID fatigue and brain fog affecting their office work and said they had decided to resign; the assistant helped draft and warm a resignation letter, and the user planned to send it Monday. After asking what to do for their health, the user received an explanation of pacing and said it clicked and left them calmer.
